note: Machine-readable cause->effect relations for the 1-ID twin simulator. 'function' points into blade.physics (or blade.alignment) where a validated implementation exists; 'evidence' keys are defined in README.md; 'confidence' says how the relation was established.

relations.control: PMU gap (mm) at fixed harmonic n
relations.physical_effect: Moves the harmonic peak; E rises with gap (smaller K). Flux at the mono energy is maximal only when the harmonic peak sits on it.
relations.formula: E_n = n*0.9496*E_ring^2/(lambda_u(1+K^2/2)), K=0.0934*B0*lambda_u, B0=a*exp(b g/lam + c (g/lam)^2)
relations.sensitivity: dE/dgap = +8.3 keV/mm (n=7, 71.7 keV), +12 keV/mm (n=9, 80.7 keV); flux peak ~0.07-0.1 mm wide in gap (n=7)
relations.confidence: model fitted to logs (21.9 mm period, 0.17% rms, 5 points); device spec not available
relations.caveats: ring energy 6 GeV and Halbach coefficients are assumptions

relations.physical_effect: The gap readback depends on approach direction; scans started from the previous end do not overlay.
relations.sensitivity: peak gap differs by ~0.004 mm between scans/days
relations.typical: open to ~9.5 mm first, setundgap, scan high->low

relations.control: SCU current (A) at fixed harmonic (2022-2023 only)
relations.physical_effect: Higher current = higher field = larger K = LOWER photon energy.
relations.sensitivity: about -0.12 to -0.13 keV per A at h=5 near 71.7 keV
relations.caveats: SCU is not modelled in blade.physics; quenches near 815/826 A

relations.physical_effect: Beam angle at the source decides how much of the undulator cone passes the WB slits and the best gap.
relations.sensitivity: -11 urad (IB) restored a 2.5x flux shortfall and the expected gap (9.080 -> 8.985 mm)
relations.typical: Xp 5-20 urad, Yp -17.5..+2 urad across sessions

relations.physical_effect: Photon flux, hence IC rates and detector counts, scale linearly with ring current.
Th1 = theta_Bragg(Si 111) + offset; the angle must follow E to stay on the Bragg condition.
relations.formula: Th1 = asin(hc/(2 d E)) + offset, d=3.1356 A

relations.physical_effect: The second crystal slides along the beam to keep a constant exit offset.
relations.caveats: derived by this project from log values, not a drawing

relations.physical_effect: A small crystal-angle change shifts the energy scale at fixed set energy.
relations.sensitivity: +0.00055 deg Th1 -> -25 eV at 71.7 keV (matches log); 0.008 deg -> ~460 eV
relations.typical: Th1 offset drifted 0.4944 -> 0.4963 deg in 2022 = +35 eV at Re

relations.control: HEM energy near a foil K edge
relations.physical_effect: mu_t of the calibration foil is a steep function of energy across the edge; the operators hold it at ~1.4 to fix the energy scale.
relations.sensitivity: +35 eV across the Re edge changed mu_t 0.946 -> 1.402; mu_t resolves ~few eV
relations.caveats: readout offset from nominal edge is 25-160 eV and varies by day (Au 0, Re -25..-75, Yb -57..-73, Hf -70 eV)

relations.control: WB slit size / gap / beam dump
relations.physical_effect: Crystal heating shifts the Bragg angle; after a cold start flux and energy recover only after thermalisation and a Th2 + gap re-peak.
relations.sensitivity: C1 +3 K at 0.4x0.4 mm, +10 K at 0.8x0.7 mm; mu_t 1.4 -> 1.5 -> 1.7 after dumps; Th2 +0.036 deg Jul->Sep 2026

relations.physical_effect: Sets acceptance, flux and heat load; flux is less than proportional to area because the beam is peaked.
Best centre follows the beam; wrong centre clips the beam and costs flux.
relations.sensitivity: centre moved ~0.8 mm H with SCU current; ~8 um V over three weeks; table yaw 0.7 mm

relations.physical_effect: Upstream slit defines the beam, downstream slit removes scatter; edge penumbra/scatter adds ~10 um.
relations.sensitivity: slit 0.110 mm -> 0.120 mm beam at the sample
relations.typical: C US 0.2x0.2 mm define, DS 0.3x0.3 mm clean-up

relations.physical_effect: Slit centre zero is tied to the beam; when the beam moves, slits must be re-zeroed on the tomo camera hot spot.
relations.sensitivity: beam moved 2.5-2.8 mm H / 0.36-0.44 mm V at B slits (APS-U), 1.7 mm IB in E; +20/-10 um after dumps
relations.typical: 100 um in the slit control = 100 um on the tomo

relations.control: lens tilt (th or phi per orientation)
relations.physical_effect: Tilting a saw-tooth lens changes its focal length; the focus moves along the beam.
relations.sensitivity: ~41 mm of focus shift per mdeg (lens1E, 71.5 m focus)
relations.confidence: model validated vs logs (4 predictions exact; measured optima within 0.002-0.010 deg)

relations.physical_effect: delta ~ 1/E^2, so at fixed tilt the focus moves with energy; refocus by re-tilting.
A support or aperture in the beam truncates it: lower flux, cut focus edge.
relations.sensitivity: B3 420 -> 650 kHz after removing CRL; OB edge cut moves with WB slits
relations.typical: after APS-U beam moved 1-2 mm IB

relations.physical_effect: Beer-Lambert attenuation of the beam.
relations.confidence: model validated (Pb foil ln(441/252)=0.559 matches ut 0.56)
relations.caveats: re-check wheel after an energy change

relations.physical_effect: IC count rate ~ photon flux x gain; dark floor 0.8-2.1 kHz; scaler clips near 1e6/s.
relations.sensitivity: IC_B1 174-178 kHz at 50 nA/V, 200 mA, WB 0.3x0.3

relations.physical_effect: Counts scale with exposure and transmission; saturation sets the maximum.
relations.sensitivity: Varex saturated at 0.1 s, attenC=1.0; ok at pos 2 / 0.32 s

relations.physical_effect: Pin column vs omega is a sinusoid; x cancels a, z cancels b, Aero X moves c (axis column).
relations.formula: x(w) = c + a cos w + b sin w
relations.sensitivity: Aero X -1431 px/mm on GH1

relations.control: rx/rz tilt of the rotation axis
relations.physical_effect: A tilted axis makes the pin tip move vertically with omega.
relations.sensitivity: 3 px (3.51 um) over 16 mm = 0.015 deg (C); E wedge ~0 (0.5 px/16 mm)

relations.physical_effect: Powder ring radius grows linearly with L.
relations.sensitivity: CeO2 (111) 277 px at 1 m, 200 um px, 71.676 keV

relations.physical_effect: Rings shrink as energy rises (2 theta ~ lambda/d).
relations.sensitivity: (111) CeO2 2 theta 3.17 deg at 71.676 keV
relations.typical: recalibrate distance/centre/tilts at each new edge

relations.physical_effect: Pixel size at the scintillator = sensor pitch / magnification; FOV = n_pixels x pixel size.
relations.sensitivity: PG1 5X 1.172, GH1 5X 0.69, Retiga 5X 1.48 um/px (all reproduced)
relations.caveats: profile retiga2 has 1.0 um/px; logs give 1.48 for the NF Retiga 5X

relations.physical_effect: At short exposures the shutter opening time/jitter sets the delivered dose per frame.
relations.sensitivity: 1 frame -> 0,1 or 2 pulses; opens late at 0.1 s frames
relations.typical: keep_open or sweep modes avoid it

relations.physical_effect: The beam hot spot jumps on the tomo camera.
relations.sensitivity: 3-15 px (~10 um at 0.69 um/px) every ~20 min

relations.control: sample position relative to the true axis
relations.physical_effect: An off-axis sample changes the effective distance.
Smaller vertical emittance: smaller focused beam, ~10% fewer IC counts after steering.
relations.sensitivity: vertical FWHM 17 vs 23 um (-26%), horizontal 30 vs 27 um (+9%)
